verdict.rationale: Atlassian's first-party docs say Jira has an app marketplace with over 3,000 integrations (Tempo Timesheets, Zephyr and others), which matches the story's "thousands of third-party tools via an app marketplace." The evidence is only short marketing claims. Missing for 10: detailed docs on installing and managing Marketplace apps from a workspace, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the marketplace experience.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can connect my workspace to thousands of third-party tools via an app marketplace

citations.quote: Choose from the over 3000+ integrations available in the Atlassian Marketplace.
Tempo Timesheets, Zephyr, and over 3,000 other apps ensure Jira Software can be custom tailored to fit any and every use case.
